individual_review_reason: The OpenStax §3.1 derivative is the ordinary real difference-quotient limit, requiring a function defined on a neighborhood of the interior point. Its existence is not assumed for every function; one-sided endpoint and generalized weak derivatives are separate notions.
mathematical_context: OpenStax calculus: finite two-sided real derivative on an open interval

individual_review_reason: OpenStax §1.1 gives the ordinary real absolute value as a piecewise function. The induced distance d(a,b)=|a−b| is an associated metric construction, not literally the same object as the unary function |·|; complex modulus and general field absolute values need distinct contexts.
mathematical_context: OpenStax elementary real algebra: piecewise absolute-value function
